semantics.both_rule: both is representable but inhabiting it yields False in consistent logic
semantics.closure_rule: TwoSidedClosure P Q closes Q only when both P->Q and not P->Q are independently constructed
semantics.negative_self_firewall: Nonempty (TwoSidedClosure P (not P)) iff not P

operator_semantics.torsion: preserves defect; never strict progress by itself
operator_semantics.excitation: strict decrease only when ExcitationValid is proved

riemann.positive_state: RH-side consequences may be mined for explicit zeta/Mellin bounds
riemann.negative_state: an explicit off-critical zero is a valid negative object and must be propagated into the BCF residue term
riemann.common_target: a quantitative classifier for the BCF residue behavior, not RH itself
riemann.forbidden_shortcut: RH or not-RH case split cannot prove RH

p_vs_np.positive_state: if SAT in P, inspect the concrete candidate machine and its canonical circuit semantics
p_vs_np.negative_state: a concrete universal-failure witness is terminal negative-side material
p_vs_np.forbidden_shortcut: P=NP or P!=NP split does not prove P!=NP

navier_stokes.positive_state: global smooth solution supplies bounded official observables
navier_stokes.negative_state: finite-time singular solution supplies a concrete blow-up witness
navier_stokes.forbidden_shortcut: smooth-or-blowup split alone proves neither branch

hodge.positive_state: algebraic cycle realization supplies concrete cycle data
hodge.negative_state: counterexample must be a concrete smooth projective variety plus rational Hodge class outside cycle span
hodge.forbidden_shortcut: Hodge or not-Hodge split cannot construct a cycle

bsd.positive_state: same-curve rank/refined identities produce arithmetic witness
bsd.negative_state: counterexample must be a concrete elliptic curve and a failed official identity
bsd.forbidden_shortcut: BSD or not-BSD split cannot replace curve model binding

yang_mills.positive_state: constructive 4D theory plus positive spectral gap
yang_mills.negative_state: concrete regulated/continuum model exhibiting zero gap or failure of required reconstruction
yang_mills.forbidden_shortcut: mass-gap or no-mass-gap split cannot replace physical construction

beal.positive_state: common-prime witness for each concrete solution
beal.common_target: candidate arithmetic classification and Frey/local-data object
beal.forbidden_shortcut: Beal or not-Beal split cannot prove Beal
